_help: Every AI model choice lives here. To upgrade a model, change its "model" line.
This installation's own changes go in instance/ai_models.json (same shape; only the fields you change; it survives updates).
kind: openai (any OpenAI-compatible API) | ollama | anthropic | gemini | huggingface.
key_env names the environment variable (.env) holding the API key; keys never go in this file.
model_env / endpoint_env: optional environment variables that override model / endpoint (kept so old .env files keep working).
default_on: part of the consensus panel as soon as it is usable. Providers not yet measured with tools/ai_benchmark.py stay off.
Add a local voice: copy an ollama entry, change its id and model, then run `ollama pull <model>` on the machine at "endpoint".

groq.notes: Measured 2026-09-19: best accuracy of everything tested, ~0.5s per answer, free tier.

ollama.notes: Auto-discovers an Ollama server and uses its first model. Prefer the named local voices below.

ollama-mistral.name: Mistral 7B (local)
ollama-mistral.notes: 4.4GB. Measured 2026-09-19: hedges on nearly everything (strict recall 20%). Keep off until weighted or replaced by a better local model.

ollama-hermes3.name: Hermes 3 8B (local)
ollama-hermes3.notes: Lighter machines (4.7GB). Measured 80% accuracy / 30% false positives, 40s per answer on CPU.

ollama-phi4.name: Phi-4 14B (local)
ollama-phi4.notes: About 9GB download. Not benchmarked yet: run tools/ai_benchmark.py before turning it on.

ollama-gemma4.name: Gemma 4 12B (local)
ollama-gemma4.notes: About 7.6GB download. Not benchmarked yet: run tools/ai_benchmark.py before turning it on.

openrouter.notes: OFF on purpose (2026-10-21). The free slug qwen/qwen3.8-27b:free returns 404; the paid slug (this one) needs credits. Free models rotate and cap at about 50 requests a day. Never benchmarked, so by the plan it gets no vote: run backend/tools/ai_benchmark.py before turning it on.

cerebras.notes: Free tier. Not benchmarked yet: run backend/tools/ai_benchmark.py before enabling.

mistral.notes: Free experimentation tier. Not benchmarked yet: run backend/tools/ai_benchmark.py before enabling.

gemini.notes: Answers well within its quota, but the free quota runs out quickly. Enable if you have a paid plan.

huggingface.notes: No longer free: the Inference Providers router needs credits (HTTP 402 since 2026-09-19). Replace it with a free provider.

anthropic.notes: Pay-per-use API, funded separately from a Claude.ai subscription (console.anthropic.com). Not benchmarked yet.

openai.name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
openai.notes: OFF until a key is added and it passes the ablation test (tools/ablation.py). A ChatGPT plan does not include API access. Check the model name and prices against OpenAI's docs before enabling; the prices here are estimates used only for the spend cap.

grok.name: Grok (xAI)
grok.notes: OFF until a key is added and it passes the ablation test. Pay as you go, no free tier. This is xAI's Grok, not Groq (a different company). The model name is a placeholder: set GROK_MODEL or edit it after checking xAI's docs.

kimi.name: Kimi (Moonshot AI)
kimi.notes: OFF until a key is added and it passes the ablation test. Cheapest paid voice (about $2 to $5 a month at 1,000 findings). Made by Moonshot AI (Beijing): not allowed in a bank deployment until that bank approves it (allowed_deployments). Check the model name against Moonshot's docs.
